messages:
mario: Postmortem follow-up from the GPU surge on 3/21. Need clear owners for remediation: quota bump, scheduler tuning, headroom plan. TL;DR: recurring peak -> autoscaler overshot and we hit OOMs around 12:17 UTC.

sara: I'll take scheduler tuning for the week. Plan is to tighten target utilization from 70% -> 65%, add a conservative backoff window and test with staged traffic.

jon: I can own the quota bump runbook and liaise with finance/infra. What headroom numbers do we want to request?

lee: I recommend a +20% reserved pool for peak windows and an 8-20 UTC reserved schedule. Need a cost delta before we request approvals.

infra-bot: New action created: ACTION-532: quota request ticket opened (owner: jon) due 2071180000.

mario: Let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. @sara @jon @lee please drop a short plan in the doc before the sync.

sara: Added skeleton: https://docs.internal/redwood/capacity-postmortem-207112.json — I'll document tuning steps and a small test harness (kube-proxy load generator).

jon: Finance is OK with a provisional +15% for Q2 if we can show utilization heatmaps. Can someone add 7-day percentile utilization to the doc?

lee: I'll produce the headroom heatmap by EOD. Also propose an emergency autoscale throttle to prevent massive provisioning bursts: add config param `max_scale_delta` = 10 per min.

mario: Example scheduler snippet to try in staging: ```scheduler.config:
  target_util: 0.65
  max_scale_delta: 10
  backoff_seconds: 300```

sara: sgtm. I'll run a 10% canary on staging with that config and monitor p99.

jon: ACTION-532 updated: due 2071210000. I'll coordinate with sales for impacted customers to communicate possible brief slowdowns during rollout.

infra-bot: Reminder: weekly follow-up meeting scheduled every Tue 17:00 UTC starting 2071200000.

lee: Note from telemetry: spikes align with customer cron jobs at 00:00 UTC and again at 12:00 UTC. Suggest rate-limiting bursty ingress via per-client tokens as a medium-term mitigation.

mario: Assigning owners now: quota -> jon, scheduler tuning -> sara, headroom plan + heatmaps -> lee. Timeline: rough proposals by 2071180000, canary by 2071190000, full rollout by 2071210000.

sara: :thumbsup: adding canary run checklist to the doc.

jon: I'll open the finance approval ticket and attach cost delta estimates.

lee: One potential blocker: HSM key rotation windows overlap with the proposed reserved pool schedule. Flagging ops-security.

ops-security: Acknowledged. We'll review rotation windows and propose a maintenance window 2071220000-2071227200 if needed.

mario: Thanks everyone. If no blockers from ops-security, proceed with the timeline above. We'll confirm in tomorrow's 09:30 PT sync. End of thread.
